visual.description: Light blue-grey gradient background of the hero section, evoking sky and openness.
Very dark near-black used as the primary dark surface for footer and dark sections.
Pure white background used for content sections between hero and footer.
Deep dark navy used for the app/phone showcase section background.
Warm terracotta/copper used as the Ownership service panel background and accent color.
Near-black used for all headings and large display type throughout the site.
Pure black used for body copy and paragraph text on white backgrounds.
Medium grey used for secondary/muted text such as country names in destination cards.
White used for footer logo and footer navigation text on dark background.
Near-black nav link text in the transparent overlay nav state over light backgrounds.
Near-black fill used for primary CTA buttons like 'All Solutions' and 'Ownership'.
Light grey used for divider lines separating destination entries and section rules.
Pale blue-grey visible as the sky-tone behind the transparent nav at top of page.
